title: Underwater recording of aquatic movement, bubbles and drops.
author: felix.blume
changes: Real underwater recording (hydrophone) of air bubbles bubbling up in a river at Praia do Sono, Brazil, used for the cave fish (cave fish make no well-known sound). Trimmed to 66.00–68.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.2 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
